data.title: Hillfort volume II has been printed!
data.excerpt: Our second volume on hillforts has been printed and from next week we will begin sending it out to everyone who ordered a copy. Not all the books are reserved yet, so there is still time to order one.
data.metaTitle: Hillfort volume II has been printed
data.metaDescription: The second volume on hillforts is printed and distribution to those who ordered begins next week; not all copies are reserved, so orders are still welcome.

mediaTexts.caption: This was how much there was in mid-November.

children.text: Our second volume on hillforts has now been printed, and from next week we will begin distributing it to everyone who has ordered it.
For those who have not managed it yet, I have good news: not all the books are reserved so far, so if you are interested, do not hesitate and
. I would remind you that the first volume sold out within a month in 2016 and that no reprint is planned.
